name: Seo-an
source:
"An imbalance of power often sows the seeds of misfortune."

Nationality: Bastet
Role: Ruler
Ability: Mind control

Seo-an is a natural-born politician who rose to power at an unusually young age, swiftly becoming the ruler of Bastet. Through quiet cunning and tireless planning, she secured the dominance of her literati families over the nation’s governance—and has kept it ever since.

Her personal motto, “Slow and steady wins the race,” isn’t just a saying. It’s her strategy. She approaches every goal with deliberate precision, never rushing, always calculating.
Each move is careful. Each silence, intentional.
And perhaps, beneath that flawless control… a flicker of envy toward Haesu lingers.
